internal.title: Incident Report: Cart Service Elevated Error Rate Resolved
internal.body:
At 12:08 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for the cart service due to a high error rate (0.25). Initial diagnosis confirmed an error injection fault type as the root cause. Latency and resource exhaustion were ruled out based on normal p95 latency (120 ms) and stable CPU and memory usage. 

Actions were taken promptly to disable the cartFailure flag at 12:28 UTC after approval, which led to a verified recovery with error rates dropping to normal levels (0.002). The incident was resolved shortly after.

Key timeline events:
- 12:08:23: Alert received
- 12:28:04: Diagnosis confirmed error injection
- 12:28:11: Flag disabled after approval
- 12:28:11: Recovery verified

No further resource or latency issues were detected during the incident.
